issues.description: The template for Exercise 5 uses a different parameter name for the auxiliary register in state_preparation (ancilla_register) than the rest of the API and the solution (auxiliary_register). This inconsistent parameter naming across methods (and compared to the problem text which refers to an auxiliary register) can confuse students about which register to pass and lead to mismatches when they integrate their implementations across methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter in the template's state_preparation signature from ancilla_register to auxiliary_register (and update any docstring references) so all methods use a consistent parameter name matching the rest of the template, the solution, and the problem statement.

issues.description: The template implementation for the Kakuro exercise uses the parameter name 'ancilla_register' in the state_preparation signature, while the problem statement and the solution implementation consistently use the term 'auxiliary_register' (and other functions in the template use 'auxiliary_register'). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the auxiliary/ancilla qubit register) creates avoidable cognitive load for students mapping the problem description to the template and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter 'ancilla_register' in template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py state_preparation signature to 'auxiliary_register' and update the function body/docstring to use 'auxiliary_register' consistently so it matches the problem text and the solution implementation.
